mapper.select: SELECT id, item_id, audit_status, auditor, remark, create_time FROM pet_item_audit WHERE item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_item_audit (item_id, audit_status, auditor, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditor}, #{remark}, NOW())
